sample: Exactly the existing 435 complete RTH and boundary quality days. These dates are consumed discovery data, not a new holdout. The 2019-2021 sample remains sealed.

candidates.MORNING_TO_CLOSE: Direction = sign(09:59 close minus prior scheduled complete RTH close in current active contract basis). Signal known at10:00. Flat or missing prior close: no trade. Enter15:30 open, exit15:59 close. This preserves the overnight-inclusive first-half-hour direction in Gao et al.; NQ translation, not their SPY replication. No 15:00 candidate, volatility filter, stop, target, sizing or optimization.
candidates.TURN_OF_MONTH_RTH: Long on last cash trading day of month and first three cash trading days, 09:30 open to15:59 close. Calendar positions include short cash sessions, but actual trades require existing full-RTH quality. Use full calendar months January2025 through September2026 only. Original McConnell-Xu result is daily close-to-close; this RTH-only NQ adaptation deliberately excludes overnight and is not an exact replication.

benchmarks: Morning: always-long same dates and15:30-16:00 slot. TOM: always-long RTH on other complete days within the same month; mean difference standardized by the count of TOM events per month, plus all-available-days long benchmark. Benchmark subtraction is descriptive, not a causal experiment.
uncertainty: 5000 resamples of whole calendar months with seed20261022051, retain within-month events. Nominal percentile95% intervals for conditional mean and benchmark difference only. 22 partial/full months give limited power. No confirmatory p-value or promotion: the separate inference proposal has not been certified for these adaptive exploratory models, sparse TOM events or four possible claims. No selective significant labels.
execution: One NQ contract, bar-open and bar-close price proxies, no intrabar stop/target paths. MFE/MAE over actual holding bars, include zero. Close fill, spread and slippage not proved without independent tick/BBO evidence. DD measured on closed-trade equity only, not intratrade margin risk.
report: All trials, gross/net totals, dollars, winrate, PF, closed-equity max DD, worst day, top3 positive/net concentration when net>0, months/quarters, long/short, MFE/MAE, cost sensitivity, benchmark difference and uncertainty. Negative trials retained. No rule changes after inspection.
